Field.name: Voltage
Field.usage: Microscope voltage in kilovolts (default 200)

Field.name: SphericalAberration
Field.usage: Spherical aberration in mm (default 2)

Field.name: BoxSize
Field.usage: Size of spectrum to analyze (default 256)
Field.manpage: Size of spectrum to analyze. Images will be reduced to this size unless the \fB-resamp\fR option is used. The box size should be increased if CTF aliasing is detected at a resolution lower than that to which the Thon rings fit. The default is 256.

Field.name: MinimumResolution
Field.usage: Minimum resolution to analyze in Angstroms (default 50)
Field.manpage: Minimum resolution in Angstroms, the low frequency limit of the range to analyze. The default is 50 A.

Field.name: MaximumResolution
Field.usage: Maximum resolution to analyze in Angstroms (default 10)
Field.manpage: Maximum resolution in Angstroms, the high frequency limit of the range to analyze. The default is 10 A.

Field.name: MinDefocus
Field.usage: Minimum defocus of search range in Angstroms (default 5000)

Field.name: MaxDefocus
Field.usage: Maximum defocus of search range in Angstroms (default 80000)

Field.name: DefocusStepSize
Field.usage: Size of defocus search step in Angstroms (default 500)

Field.name: FastSearch
Field.usage: Use faster, less accurate search method

Field.name: AstigmatismTolerance
Field.usage: Astigmatism tolerance; limit on amount of astigmatism in Angstroms

Field.name: AstigmatismIsKnown
Field.usage: Astigmatism is known; use this option to prevent astigmatism search

Field.name: KnownAstigmatism
Field.usage: Known astigmatism in Angstroms (default 0)
Field.manpage: Known astigmatism in Angstroms. The default is 0, so there is no need to enter this option or the next one if \fB-known\fR is entered just to prevent the astigmatism search

Field.name: AstigmatismAngle
Field.usage: Known astigmatism angle in degrees (default 0)

Field.name: NoExtraComputations
Field.usage: No extra computations of resolution fit to or CTF aliasing resolution
Field.manpage: Skip extra computations used to assess the resolution that Thon rings fit to or the resolution at which CTF aliasing is detected.

Field.name: LowDoseImages
Field.usage: Input images are relatively noisy; use for tilt series images
Field.manpage: Input images are relatively noisy; this option makes the program skip a weighting of the power spectrum that attenuates lower frequencies. The Ctffind program started showing poorer performance for doses under ~10 electrons/pixel or ~3 electrons/square Angstrom in version 4.1.9 because of this weighting. This option restores the performance to what it was in 4.1.8. It should be used for tilt series images.

Field.name: FindPhaseShift
Field.usage: Find additional phase shift

Field.name: MinimumPhaseShift
Field.usage: Minimum phase shift to search, in radians
Field.manpage: Minimum phase shift to search, in radians. A negative value must be entered to find a negative phase shift.

Field.name: MaximumPhaseShift
Field.usage: Maximum phase shift to search, in radians

Field.name: PhaseStepSize
Field.usage: Phase shift search step in radians (default 0.1)

Field.name: ResampleSpectrum
Field.usage: Resample amplitude spectrum to this resolution in Angstroms
Field.manpage: Resample amplitude spectrum to the given resolution in Angstroms. In practice, this means that the spectrum is computed within a box that is larger than the final box size by half of this value divided by the pixel size, and the final box is extracted from this larger box.

Field.name: SectionRangeToDo
Field.usage: Starting and ending section numbers to analyze, numbered from 0

Field.name: ParameterFile
Field.usage: Read parameter entries from file
Field.manpage: Read parameter entries from this file.

Field.name: usage
Field.usage: Print help output
